record.student_summary: You can do your summer internship as CPT if your department approves it for credit. Because the internship goes past your current program end date, your I-20 will be extended to December 15, 2027. Send your offer letter today and wait for your new I-20 before starting work. One summer of full-time CPT will still leave you eligible for OPT. For winter travel, get a travel signature before you leave and renew your visa before returning if it has expired.
